titles.en: Stele of Heng Fang, Qing rubbing

productionDate.note: The catalogue gives only the dynasty. The year the rubbing was taken is not recorded, so no year is stored.

dimensions.raw: 纵 223 厘米，横 107 厘米
dimensions.note: The catalogue does not state whether the figure describes the mounted sheet or the inked image.

relationships.note: The catalogue identifies the rubbing as taken from this stele.

currentCollection.note: Published in the Palace Museum's online collection catalogue under object number 新00046098. The entry gives no gallery, accession date, or exhibition status.
currentCollection.noteZh: 著录于故宫博物院线上藏品目录，馆藏编号新00046098。条目没有说明展厅、入藏时间或展出状态。

review.note: Draft object record from the museum's catalogue entry read on 2026-11-18. The rubbing's condition, acquisition and mounting history are not stated.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-18 阅读的馆方目录条目整理。拓本的保存状况、入藏与装裱经过均未记载。

notes: The entry describes the ink as fine and notes two character-level features (将 partly preserved, 仪之 joined); these are the cataloguer's observations, not a condition survey.
A Qing date is all the catalogue gives; no narrower date is inferred.
The rubbing's size is not the stele's size, and the two records do not share dimensions.
notesZh: 条目称拓墨精良，并记「将」字存少半、「仪之」已连；这是编目者的观察，不是保存状况调查。
目录只给「清」，不据此推断更具体的年份。
拓片尺寸不等于碑石尺寸，两条实物记录不共用尺寸。
